preStated.thesis: strategy beats equal-weight rotation AND momentum rotation on mean annualized per-position return

methodology.priceSeries: Zillow ZHVI metro mid-tier all-homes monthly (residential repeat-sales index)
methodology.whyIndex: Actual transaction prices are sparse + irregular per asset (CRE trades every 5-10yr) and composition-biased (the mix of what sells shifts by cycle). A repeat-sales index is the methodologically correct way to track metro price MOVEMENT over time. Institutional validation (RCA / Green Street CPPI / CoStar) is a roadmap requiring data access — used to spot-check index moves against real deals, not to form the backtest series.
methodology.returns: appreciation-only (no leverage, no transaction costs, no NOI/cap-rate cash flows)
methodology.whatThisProxiesFor: the price/valuation channel of CRE returns, directionally — NOT deal-level CRE prices
methodology.leverageNote: 1.0x leverage assumed; institutional CRE typically 50-70% LTV which would amplify ALL strategies' returns proportionally

config.thinSampleCaveat: ~9yr window, 2-4yr holds → only ~2-3 non-overlapping holds per metro. Aggregate per-strategy n is moderate but each individual call has low precision. Treat findings as directional, not statistically conclusive.
